title: organizational_relation.ended event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 20.5/19e.20. Produced by epd2_organization_service.events.build_organizational_relation_ended_event. Minimum payload only: the relation's own id, its new status (ended), effective_time (the relation's own valid_until, or the occurrence time if valid_until was not yet set at the moment of ending), and recorded_at.
